additional_concerns: The circular says the measures “will take immediate effect” in u1 but also sets 28 November 2025 as the Effective Date in u9. The date used by the rule, and the legally relevant assessment event, require clarification from the referenced FAQs.

The legacy flag fixes the no-approval condition at 28 November 2025. The transition sentence does not explicitly specify that snapshot date or establish how an application granted approval later affects eligibility.
The rule's FALSE result must remain limited to failure to establish this relief; neither an exception nor failure of home-jurisdiction compliance independently establishes a current approval duty.

The circular does not define novel or complex features, local policy implications, or the operational requirements in the referenced FAQs. The supplied external dependency records have null source hashes, so those materials cannot be treated as available authority.
